summary: Iteration 31: End-to-end testing of new chain sponsor features (Chain Pitch Page, Card Download Buttons on SponsorStatus, and chain-mode BecomeSponsorDialog). Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering subscription-status (active+unknown), social-card downloads (square/story/pdf with correct content-type & size >50KB), subscribe endpoint chain validation + PayPal 503 (expected in preview), tier fallback for garbage values, plus regressions on /api/sponsors/active, /api/coupons/chains-nearby (FORK20 present), /api/stats/fates. Frontend: /sponsor/chains renders hero, fates counter, 3 how-it-works steps, pricing card ($99/mo + $990/yr + 2 months free), both CTAs open chain-mode dialog with coupon section, auto-uppercase coupon code confirmed (abc123->ABC123), no-coupon toast fires ('Chain sponsorships require a coupon code and offer description'), full-payload submit yields expected 503 toast ('Online sponsorship isn't available yet — please email us.'). /sponsor/success?subscription_id=I-TESTSUB123 polls, shows 'You're live!' with 3 download links pointing to correct /api/sponsors/test-chain-sponsor-1/social-card?format=X URLs. Regression: normal local sponsor dialog from header still shows $19/mo (Founder, $29 strikethrough, First month FREE) and $190/yr with no coupon section. All acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: SponsorStatus.jsx polling caps at 6 tries (~15s). If PayPal webhook is delayed, user may see 'pending' even though sponsor will activate — consider a manual 'Check again' button.
Chain dialog reuses shared photo upload/website fields; consider hiding those for chain_coupon_only tier since chains don't get a fate-deck slot and only the coupon strip is used.
